name: choi_matrix_classical
divergence_log: Classical Choi is block-diagonal; misses off-diagonal coherences that witness non-CP-divisible or entanglement-breaking distinctions. Choi rank=1 (unitary) is unreachable classically except for permutations. No Jamiolkowski isomorphism subtlety: state-channel duality is trivial on diagonals. Classical Choi cannot detect PPT/NPT entanglement and is always separable.
